extracted.name: BBQ Meatballs
extracted.description: A crowd-pleasing slow cooker BBQ meatball appetizer recipe is easy to prepare and bursting with barbecue flavor. Perfect for when you want a no-fuss hit.
instruction_lines: Place barbecue sauce, meatballs, and ketchup in a slow cooker. Cover slow cooker. Cook on a Low heat for 4 hours, stirring occasionally.
